newsitem.title: CHINA: China to launch southern power plant next month.
newsitem.headline: China to launch southern power plant next month.

text.p: China's southern Guangdong province will start construction of a 1,400 megawatt power plant in Zhuhai city next month, the Xinhua news agency said on Thursday.
The first phase of the Zhuhai Power Plant was scheduled for completion in 1999 and involved a total investment of more than 10 billion yuan ($1.2 billion), the agency said.
The Export-Import Bank of Japan and Mitsubishi Bank Ltd would grant $670 million in export credits to the plant, which will have two 700-megawatt coal-fired generating units, it said.
The project is expected to supply electricity to the western part of booming Guangdong province and to the neighbouring Portuguese territory of Macau.
The generators would be built by turnkey contractors Mitsubishi Heavy Industries and Mitsubishi Corp.
